components.name: sherpa-onnx Windows CUDA 12 (research pin)
components.distribution: Upstream GitHub release; pinned by whisper_catalog.rs research metadata but not called by the active model installer.
components.attribution: sherpa-onnx / k2-fsa / Xiaomi contributors; retain Apache-2.0 and notices for ONNX Runtime, kaldi-decoder, kaldi-native-fbank, OpenFst, simple-sentencepiece, nlohmann/json and hclust.
components.conditions: Preserve all applicable native dependency licenses and copyright notices; the top-level Apache license alone does not describe every linked component. Keep the source/build correspondence for the exact binary.
components.verification: Source-only research pin. The active GPU installer uses CUDA 13; the CUDA 12 pin is retained by cuda_runtime_pins(), referenced only in a test. The 595 MB archive was not downloaded.
issues: Source dependencies are pinned, but a complete binary-linked dependency bill of materials is still needed; source tree licenses can overinclude unused code.

Pinned CUDA build leaves TTS enabled by default, links piper_phonemize and statically built eSpeak NG; the exact eSpeak fork's source is GPL-3.0-or-later. This strongly indicates a GPL-linked DLL; 478 MB archive/binary linkage was not independently inspected.
Do not label this complete CUDA runtime Apache-only or assume a user opt-in resolves GPL/NVIDIA compatibility.
This research-only archive is not currently installed by the app; any future activation requires a separate binary/notice review.
components.recommendation: Before release, replace with a verified ASR-only CUDA build using SHERPA_ONNX_ENABLE_TTS=OFF and review its full native dependencies, or obtain legal review of the existing GPL-linked combination. Disable distribution of this runtime until resolved if no compliant build is available.
